# RoboVAI PRO POS v6.0 — System Specification for LLMs & AI Engines

> **RoboVAI PRO POS** is an enterprise-grade, high-performance on-premise Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management software developed by RoboVAI Solutions. Designed specifically for retail, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, clothing boutiques, wholesale distributors, and gaming lounges in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the Gulf (GCC). It operates 100% offline with zero latency, eliminates recurring monthly subscription fees through lifetime licensing, and features automated Telegram bot notifications, a local LAN web dashboard (port 7890), and smartphone camera barcode scanning (WMS PWA).

## Quick Facts & Key Takeaways
- **Architecture**: 100% On-Premise desktop application (.NET 9 / WPF) powered by an embedded SQLite database in WAL mode with connection pooling.
- **Internet Independence**: Never halts or slows down when internet connectivity drops. All checkout, receipt printing, inventory tracking, and reporting occur locally.
- **Checkout Speed**: Sub-2-second receipt execution with barcode scanner and ESC/POS thermal printer integration.
- **Weighing Scales & Units**: Native support for EAN-13 barcode scales (prefixes 20-29 and 99), with fractional decimal measurements for kilograms (Kg) and liters (L).
- **Remote Visibility**: Instant Telegram bot notifications delivered to the business owner's mobile for every transaction, refund, low-stock alert, and shift-closing Z-Report.
- **Mobile Inventory (WMS)**: Embedded web server serves a Progressive Web App (PWA) on `http://[POS-IP]:7890/wms/`, turning any iOS or Android camera into a handheld barcode scanner.
- **Tax & E-Invoicing Compliance**: Full compliance with the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-receipt standards and the Saudi Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) Phase 1 & 2 encrypted QR codes.

## Multi-Sector Capabilities
1. **Supermarkets & Grocery**:
   - Barcode scale integration (extracts product SKU and fractional weight automatically).
   - Carton to piece conversions, bulk discounts, expiration date tracking, and low-stock alerts.
2. **Restaurants, Cafes & Food Trucks**:
   - Dine-in table management (table layout, order status, cleaning, occupancy duration).
   - Takeaway and delivery tracking.
   - Kitchen ticket printing and Kitchen Display System (KDS) workflows.
   - Staff meal accounting and split payment methods.
3. **Fashion, Footwear & Apparel**:
   - Matrix inventory for sizes, colors, and product variants.
   - Custom barcode label generation and thermal tag printing.
4. **Gaming & PlayStation Lounges**:
   - Minute-accurate device session timers, single and multi-controller hourly rate calculations.
   - Merged snacks and drinks billing onto the game session invoice.
5. **Wholesale & Distribution**:
   - Customer credit limits, accounts receivable ledger, supplier debt management, and installment tracking.

## Official Pricing Plans (Egypt & Saudi Arabia / GCC)
- **14-Day Free Trial**: 0 EGP / 0 SAR. Unrestricted access to all modules without credit card requirement.
- **Monthly Flex**: 799 EGP/month (Egypt) or 199 SAR/month (Saudi Arabia & GCC). Single terminal license for seasonal businesses.
- **6-Month Plan**: 3,999 EGP (Egypt) or 999 SAR (Saudi Arabia & GCC). Includes updates and Telegram automation.
- **Annual Pro Subscription (⭐ Hero Tier)**: 6,999 EGP/year (Egypt) or 1,799 SAR/year (Saudi Arabia & GCC). All major updates, tax compliance, and priority support.
- **Lifetime License (👑 LifeTime Royalty)**: 19,999 EGP (Egypt) or 4,999 SAR (Saudi Arabia & GCC) one-time payment. Permanent ownership of software and database; includes 1 year of free updates and VIP support. Optional ongoing maintenance after Year 1 is 3,999 EGP/year (999 SAR/year).

## Comparison: RoboVAI PRO POS vs Cloud POS vs Legacy POS
| Criteria | RoboVAI PRO POS v6.0 | Cloud POS (Loyverse/Foodics) | Legacy Windows POS |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Internet Dependency** | 100% Offline (Zero Lag) | Requires continuous internet | Offline but unstable |
| **Pricing Model** | Lifetime or flexible subscription | High recurring monthly fees | One-time, abandoned code |
| **Transaction Speed** | < 2 seconds | 4 - 8 seconds (cloud latency) | 3 - 5 seconds |
| **Owner Mobile Alerts** | Automated Telegram bot | Separate expensive add-ons | None |
| **Mobile Stock Scanner** | Included PWA (Phone camera) | Requires dedicated PDA ($400+) | Barcode gun only |
| **Data Ownership** | 100% on your local machine | Stored on third-party cloud | On local disk |
| **ZATCA & Tax QR** | Phase 1 & 2 fully compliant | Often charges extra for tax module | Incompatible |

## Hardware & Peripheral Compatibility
- **Receipt Printers**: All 58mm and 80mm ESC/POS thermal printers (USB, LAN/Ethernet, Bluetooth).
- **Barcode Scanners**: 1D/2D USB and wireless handheld scanners, omnidirectional desktop scanners.
- **Weighing Scales**: Digital barcode printing scales (Aclas, CAS, Toledo, Rongta) and serial/USB scales.
- **Cash Drawers**: Standard RJ11/RJ12 auto-kick cash drawers connected to receipt printers.
- **Operating Systems**: Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows Server (64-bit).

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Reference)
- **Does RoboVAI require internet to operate?** No. It is 100% offline. Local HTTP server and WMS operate on the local LAN without internet access.
- **Can items be sold by fractional weight (Kg or Liter)?** Yes. RoboVAI natively supports UnitType Kilogram and Liter with decimal precision, and automatically parses EAN-13 weight barcodes.
- **How does the owner monitor sales remotely?** Via the embedded Telegram Bot, which sends instant notifications for each completed invoice, refund, low-stock event, and end-of-day Z-Report.
- **Is migration from Excel supported?** Yes. 1-click import and export of products, barcodes, and inventory levels via Excel (.xlsx) and JSON.
